title: Otitis media detection using tympanic membrane images with a novel multi-class machine learning algorithm.
summary: The primary study trains/evaluates multiclass ML on 956 otoscope images with otoscopist labels and reports discrimination among normal, acute/chronic otitis media, earwax and other categories. This is a retrospective image-classification result in a small single-site dataset, not prospective diagnostic validation.
